correctness.rationale: Boolean congruences on finite powersets are symmetric-difference kernels S. Compatibility is equivalent to S being forward closed in the essential-dependency graph, by single-coordinate toggles. On an invariant partition quotient, restriction of global S collapses precisely partition blocks wholly contained in S. Minimal forward closure gives an exact necessary-and-sufficient extension criterion. checker.py independently compares it with direct congruence enumeration for each of all 8000 monotone operators, checks 500 arbitrary functions, and verifies fixed point/orbit counts.

value.rationale: Monotonicity is a motivated weakening of additivity studied in the primary work; the 8-element Boolean algebra is the first carrier where CEP can fail. Quantifying all 8000 isotone maps and 492 failure orbits reveals the actual structural prevalence, while the exact all-finite dependency graph test offers an explanatory tool beyond brute enumeration. This is not an arbitrary unmotivated slice or known unrestricted-table recomputation.
